The Godfather of AI, Nvidia reports its quarterly earnings tomorrow.

Cloud revenue across the Big 3 accelerated to 43% growth, with aggregate operating margins climbing to a record 39%. Against that spending wave, consensus models expect Nvidia revenue growth to moderate to 13% quarter-over-quarter, down from 20% or more in prior quarters.

McKinsey & Company surveyed 419 B2B pricing executives and asked two questions.
 
(1) Where is your biggest margin opportunity? 62% named discount approval and governance.
 
(2) Where are you putting the money? 22% named discount approval and governance.
 
Renewals scored worse: 60% for impact. 13% for investment.
 
Sit with that for a second. The function every executive identifies as the place margin escapes is the function almost none of them fund. Meanwhile the budget flows to market intelligence, which the same respondents ranked dead last for impact and first for spend.
